velden.kop: Marc Van Ranst is blamed for what Fauci supposedly concealed, but Fauci did not conceal any harm and Van Ranst did not write the advice for pregnant women
velden.oordeel_zin: Fauci wrote in a text message about a theoretical risk, not about harm, and studies of tens of thousands of pregnant women found no higher risk; Van Ranst was not in the group that wrote the advice for pregnant women in Belgium [2] [8] [16].
velden.bewering: Marc van Ranst has been tweeting in a PANIC since it came out that Fauci KNEW vaccines were HARMFUL to pregnant women but CONCEALED it anyway! Van Ranst should be PUNISHED for his part in the corona fraud!
velden.kort: A post on X wants the Belgian virologist Marc Van Ranst to be punished because Anthony Fauci supposedly concealed that vaccines are harmful to pregnant women [15]. In January 2021, Fauci wrote in a text message about a theoretical possibility, not about harm, and research on tens of thousands of pregnant women found no higher risk of miscarriage [2] [6] [8]. Van Ranst does not appear in the text messages, and the Belgian advice for pregnant women came from a group of the Superior Health Council that he was not part of [16] [17].
velden.tekst:
On Wednesday, August 12, 2026, at 7:23 p.m., a post appeared on X with a large photo of Marc Van Ranst, a virologist at KU Leuven and the Rega Institute [15] [18]. Van Ranst is said to have been tweeting in a panic since it came out that Fauci knew vaccines were harmful to pregnant women, and concealed it [15]. For that reason he should be punished for his part in what the post calls corona fraud [15]. Two days earlier, a Dutch-language post had already gone around blaming Fauci for the same thing [15].

Van Ranst and the advice for pregnant women

In 2020 and 2021, Van Ranst advised the Belgian government in groups on the measures against corona, such as the GEES and the GEMS [20] [21]. On vaccination, the Superior Health Council advised in Belgium, with its own group for vaccines [16]. In January 2021, that council advised against vaccinating all pregnant women, and in April 2021 it gave them priority [17] [16] [19]. Van Ranst is not in the working group that wrote that advice, and not in the list of experts who approved it [16].

Van Ranst does not appear in Fauci's text messages [2] [3]. He did defend Fauci on X in December 2022, when Elon Musk wrote that Fauci should be prosecuted [22]. We did not find a post in which Van Ranst wrote about the text messages in August 2026.

What Fauci wrote

On August 10, 2026, the American senators Ron Johnson and Rand Paul released screenshots of text messages from the phone that Fauci used as director of the American institute for infectious diseases [1] [3]. The Department of Health had handed that phone over to the Senate on August 5 [1].

The text messages are from January 25 and 26, 2021, between Fauci, the then director of the CDC Rochelle Walensky, and Vivek Murthy, soon afterwards surgeon general again, the highest doctor of the American government [2] [3]. Murthy asked whether pregnant women were better vaccinated early or late in pregnancy, and Fauci replied that there were no data or theoretical reason for that [2]. A colleague wrote to him that afternoon that the first studies avoided vaccinating in the first trimester, because of possible fever and the higher number of miscarriages in that period [2]. After that, Fauci wrote that fever after the second shot "theoretically could be associated with miscarriage in the 1st trimester" [2] [4].

A day later he wrote that the risks had to be weighed against those of covid in pregnancy, and that no problems had been seen in more than 10,000 vaccinated pregnant women [3]. In February 2021 he said in public that there were no warning signals in pregnant women [4]. He did not mention the theoretical concern about fever there, but he had no data on harm in private either [3] [13].

What research found

Among 2,456 pregnant women who received an mRNA vaccine before 20 weeks, the chance of a miscarriage was 13 to 14 percent, within what is usual even without a vaccine [6]. In the United States and in Norway, women with a miscarriage had not been vaccinated shortly before more often than women with an ongoing pregnancy [7] [8]. A review of 21 studies with almost 150,000 women found no higher risk [9]. The full data from the CDC registry, covering 12,097 pregnancies, came out at 10.8 percent in February 2026 [10].

An old figure also went around again with the text messages: 82 percent miscarriages after vaccination [12]. That comes from a preliminary study of April 2021, and is miscalculated: it divides the miscarriages by a group of women most of whom were still pregnant [5] [12]. The first Dutch-language post also refers to reports in VAERS, the American reporting system for side effects [15]. According to its administrators, that system is not made to determine whether a vaccine caused a complaint [11]. On August 12, Knack called a claim about the same text messages false [23].

Van Ranst as a target

In May 2021, Van Ranst was threatened by name by an armed soldier, Jürgen Conings, and he was in a safe house with his family until Conings was found dead in June [24] [25]. According to VRT NWS, five years later he still receives hate mail [25].
velden.niet_weten: We found no post or statement by Van Ranst about the text messages, on X, on Bluesky or in Belgian media. The post does not say what corona fraud it refers to. We do not know which studies Fauci's colleague meant; the senators also say they do not know [2]. Of the more than 34,000 messages on the phone, a small portion has been released [1].
